scope: Necessary-condition admissibility audit, not a full Kryptos attack or test of every possible geometric cipher.
freeze_status: Recorded before computing family feasibility; parent supplied candidate parity argument, which this audit will independently calculate and verify. This is a pre-test operational specification, not a blind or historical preregistration.
code: code_b(T) = sum(v(T)[j] * b**j for j in range(35)), with the input feature order unchanged.
training_note: The supplied position interval has 13 positions but EASTNORTHEAST has 13 letters; validate programmatically and fail closed on any mismatch.

heldout.policy: Do not evaluate unless at least one family survives the training crib; do not use for tuning.

feedback: After encrypting/decrypting letter i, K_(i+1) = a*K_i + c + d*code_(b_i)(T_i) (mod 26).
parameters: a,c,d are fixed independent residues in 0..25; arbitrary initial K; independent integer b_i>=2 at every position. No resets, routes, masks, feature reorder, or position-specific coefficients.
decision_rule: Reject a family only if no (a mod 2,c mod 2,d mod 2) satisfies every within-training-crib transition, allowing each transition either possible base parity. Generate an exact contradiction certificate using the minimum number of training transitions, breaking ties lexicographically by transition index.
parity_theorem: For integer b even, code_b(T) mod 2 = v(T)[0] mod 2; for integer b odd it is sum(v(T)) mod 2. A modular-26 recurrence must satisfy its reduction modulo 2.
cross_check: Exhaustively enumerate all 26^3 coefficient triples with independently selectable code residues for each transition. Integer polynomial residues depend only on b mod 26, so b=2..27 cover every allowed integer base. This is an independent modular-26 consistency check, not an expansion of the family.
controls: Reconstruct vectors from frozen glyph component names and feature order, and compare to stored vectors.
Validate every feature count and bit-0 classification; check even-code qualifying and odd-code counterexample letters at both even and odd bases.
Compare exact big-integer polynomial evaluation with Horner and modular evaluation on small and huge bases.
Generate round-trip ciphertext for all eight families using varied integer-base schedules, including digit+2 schedules for radices 10,12,16,60 and arbitrary huge bases.
Check after-letter update alignment independently and include a pre-update mutation that must fail a pinned test.
Ensure parity and modular-26 admissibility solvers retain planted coefficients in positive synthetic cases.
Independently verify each reported contradiction against all 8 parity triples.

auxiliary_closure_check.base_freedom: Independent choice at each position, covering digit+2 for radices 10,12,16,60.
auxiliary_closure_check.rule: Reject this separate direct map if any training position has no allowed base; this is not evidence about feedback families.

stopping_rule: If all eight primary families fail modulo 2, stop root/digit search. Report only the named first-order affine family with frozen glyphs excluded. Complete synthetic controls and replay bundle; do not evaluate heldout.
source_note: Ciphertext and alphabets supplied by parent; source pin supplied as https://github.com/reggiechan74/kryptos-k4/blob/0d138240fb248d0b74942efc86a51d895946921d/data/k4.json. No live fetch required for deterministic input audit.
